title: Deployment, Release & Monitoring
topology: OVH Singapore single-host Docker Compose; Caddy public 80/443 only; no HA or zero-downtime claim.
promotion: One scanned OCI digest promoted across environments; configuration and secrets external.

incident.automation: 24x7 alert delivery and approved safe action
incident.s1OutsideCoverage: Best effort until backup On-call or managed service is approved.

rollback: Previous approved digest/config only when schema compatible; data restore requires incident/recovery authority.
noGo: open High without valid exceptional approval
disclaimer: The release design is approved for implementation. No release is authorized until build-specific gates and evidence pass.
